thought.text: Das ist ein fundamentales Problem - WorldTickbraucht ~20 Dependencies aber ServerBootstrap übergibt nur ws! Lass mich sehen ob es einen Factory oder DI gibt:

reasoning_content:
The server creates WorldTick with only `ws` but WorldTick expects ALL those dependencies. This is a fundamental bug in ServerBootstrap - it's not passing the dependencies.

This is actually a major design flaw in the codebase - the WorldTick class has a constructor that requires MANY dependencies but ServerBootstrap only passes ws.

I need to either:
1. Fix ServerBootstrap to properly create WorldTick with all dependencies
2. Or change WorldTick to create its own dependencies internally (DI/IoC)

Given the complexity, option 2 might be faster. Let me check if WorldTick can be self-contained or has static factories.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

print("=== 3. CHECK FACTORY PATTERNS ===")

# Check for static factory or getInstance patterns
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("grep -n 'static create\\|static instance\\|getInstance' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/WorldTick.ts 2>/dev/null | head -10")
print("WorldTick factory:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check if systems have singleton pattern
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("grep -n 'static.*instance' /opt/areloria/server/src/managers/*.ts 2>/dev/null | head -10")
print("\nManager singletons:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check PersistenceManager - can create inline
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cat /opt/areloria/server/src/modules/persistence/persistenceBackend.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30")
print("\nBackend interface:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
